channel.name: A&E CA
channel.title: Zombie House Flipping: Family Business
channel.desc: Tommy Harr bets big on a rundown rural property no other flipper would touch and calls in his family to help pull off the impossible; but once demolition begins, the surprises stack up: major structural damage, infestations, and a back addition with no foundation; what starts as a risky flip quickly turns into a full-scale rebuild; in a bold move to boost value, Tommy gambles on adding a 400-square-foot addition; the move puts even more pressure on his mom, Katie, to design and sell the home.
